sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: minden nap means every day; néha means sometimes.

items.english: Sometimes I go in the afternoon.

sections.content: minden nap is literally "every day" word for word — minden does the job of "every" all on its own, no suffix needed on nap. That's the easy end of the frequency scale; néha ("sometimes") is just as simple, a single unchanging word you can drop in anywhere.
